Topic.label: Integrated Practice: Investigating Patterns in Daylight Duration

Question: In the Northern Hemisphere, daylight is longest on the summer solstice. How is this shown on a trend chart? (The vertical axis represents daylight duration, and the horizontal axis represents the date.)

Choices.A: The highest point (peak) of the curve
Choices.B: The lowest point of the curve
Choices.C: The intersection of the curve with the horizontal axis

Solution: The maximum daylight duration corresponds to the point on the curve with the greatest vertical coordinate, namely the highest point (peak).

Original.prompt: 北半球夏至日昼最长，这一点在趋势图上表现为什么？（图中纵轴为昼长，横轴为日期）
Original.explanation: 昼长最大，对应曲线纵坐标最大的点，即最高点（峰值）。
